ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Cabinet File Execution Via Msdt.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of msdt.exe using the "cab" flag which could indicates suspicious diagcab files with embedded answer files leveraging CVE-2022-30190

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\msdt\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "msdt\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-cab\\ .*"))
